id: java-xwiki-xhtml-printer-raw-output-unescaped-html-macro-close
title: XHTML printer printRaw passes raw content to super without escaping {{/html}}
summary: An XHTML printer override of printRaw forwards the raw string straight to the parent printer.
  Raw content containing "{{/html}}", or ending with a prefix of it, can close the surrounding HTML macro
  when the output is re-parsed as wiki syntax. This lets an attacker break out of the macro and inject
  arbitrary wiki content or macros, leading to XSS or code execution.
cwe:
- CWE-79
- CWE-74
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- java
source:

  ref: 92bc8095ed3acce15ab200c8525e1623b4898be5
  vulnerable_ref: 92bc8095ed3acce15ab200c8525e1623b4898be5^

  repository: https://github.com/xwiki/xwiki-rendering
rule:
  message: 'printRaw forwards the raw argument to super.printRaw without escaping "{{/html}}" (or its
    prefixes at the end of the content). The raw content can close the enclosing HTML macro and inject
    wiki syntax.

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern-inside: "public void printRaw(String $RAW)\n{\n  ...\n}\n"
  - pattern: super.printRaw($RAW)
  - pattern-not-inside: "public void printRaw(String $RAW)\n{\n  ...\n  $RAW.replace(\"{{/html}}\", ...);\n\
      \  ...\n}\n"
fix:
  guidance: Before delegating to the parent printRaw, replace every "{{/html}}" in the raw content with
    an escaped form such as "{{/html}}". Also escape any trailing prefix of "{{/html}}" (for
    example "{", "{{", "{{/h") at the end of the content, so that raw output followed by plain text cannot
    assemble the closing macro marker. Pass the escaped string to super.printRaw.
  example: "@Override\npublic void printRaw(String raw)\n{\n    handleSpaceWhenStartElement();\n    String\
    \ escapedRaw = raw.replace(\"{{/html}}\", \"{{/html}}\");\n    StringBuilder prefix = new\
    \ StringBuilder();\n    for (Character c : List.of('{', '/', 'h', 't', 'm', 'l', '}', '}')) {\n  \
    \      prefix.append(c);\n        if (escapedRaw.endsWith(prefix.toString())) {\n            escapedRaw\
    \ = escapedRaw.substring(0, escapedRaw.length() - prefix.length())\n                + \"{\" +\
    \ prefix.substring(1);\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    super.printRaw(escapedRaw);\n  \
    \  this.elementEnded = true;\n}\n"
